Tamil Nadu political drama: Allegations of horse-trading and corruption surface

Political tensions in Tamil Nadu have escalated following allegations of horse-trading and corruption involving the DMK and the TVK party. A TVK MLA reported being offered a bribe to switch allegiance, leading to three arrests. Meanwhile, MDMK leader Vaiko faced questions about his criticism of the DMK while in alliance, leading to a heated exchange at a press conference.
